blurb: Abercrombie Country Club is a centennial golf course in Pictou County, Nova Scotia, welcoming all skill levels from beginner to pro. They offer golf instruction by Class ‘A’ PGA of Canada Professionals and custom club fitting services. Guests can dine on comfort food and pub classics with local drinks after their round.
